purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited.

candidates.name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
candidates.notes: 7.7k grade-school science MC questions (Easy+Challenge), 4 choices. Ideal WSTU science MCQ.

candidates.name: OpenBookQA
candidates.notes: 6k elementary science MC questions requiring multi-hop reasoning over a supplied fact set.

candidates.name: SciQ
candidates.notes: 13.7k science MC questions with supporting evidence; crowd-sourced. Good context+choices+answer triple.

candidates.name: QASC
candidates.notes: 9.9k 8-choice science questions requiring composition of two facts. Reasoning-heavy.

candidates.name: ScienceQA
candidates.notes: 21k multimodal science MC questions with lecture+explanation fields. Text-only subset usable now; image parts => multimodal future_candidate.

candidates.name: ScienceQA (text only)
candidates.notes: Text-only projection of ScienceQA; drops image dependency so it fits WSTU v0.1 text-only.

candidates.name: MedQA (USMLE)
candidates.notes: USMLE-style medical MC questions, 4 options. Domain-shifted but clean MCQ+answer structure.

candidates.name: MedMCQA
candidates.notes: 194k medical entrance-exam MCQs with explanations and subject/topic labels. Large, clean MCQ.

candidates.name: PubMedQA
candidates.notes: Biomedical context + question -> YES/NO/MAYBE label. Directly matches WSTU YES/NO output class.

candidates.name: MedQA (BigBIO)
candidates.notes: BigBIO standardized packaging of MedQA (multiple language/format configs). Overlaps GBaker version -> dedup.

candidates.name: BioASQ
candidates.notes: Biomedical QA challenge data. Third-party mirror: original challenge terms must be verified before any commercial use.
